license_required.quote: Any person who shall practice or attempt to practice as a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or licensed nursing assistant in this state without a license shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3.

name.quote: "Board" means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3.

type.quote: The board may: I. Establish reasonable and uniform standards for nursing practice consistent with the criteria identified by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing.

umbrella_agency.quote: certificates issued by the office of professional licensure and certification

moral_character_required.quote: Have committed no acts or omissions which are grounds for disciplinary action as set forth in this chapter, or, if such acts have been committed and would be grounds for disciplinary action, the board has found, after investigation, that sufficient restitution has been made.

degree_required.value: Graduate degree from an accredited advanced practice registered nurse education program (for APRN); graduation from a board-approved nursing education program (for RN/LPN)
degree_required.quote: Have graduated with a graduate degree earned in an accredited advanced practice registered nurse education program or have graduated before July 1, 2004 from an APRN education program accredited by a national accrediting body

accrediting_body.value: National accrediting body recognized by the United States Department of Education; specialized nursing accrediting bodies recognized by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: Receive institutional regional or national accreditation in addition to specialized nursing accreditation by accrediting bodies recognized by the United States Department of Education.

degree_level.quote: Have graduated with a graduate degree earned in an accredited advanced practice registered nurse education program

school_approval_basis.quote: Receive institutional regional or national accreditation in addition to specialized nursing accreditation by accrediting bodies recognized by the United States Department of Education.

credential_pegged.quote: Be currently certified by a board-recognized national certifying body in the specialty for which the applicant was educated

tiers.quote: Have graduated with a graduate degree earned in an accredited advanced practice registered nurse education program

required.quote: Applicants for licensure by exam as an RN or LPN shall graduate from or verify successful completion and eligibility for graduation from a board approved nursing education program or a program that meets criteria comparable to those established by the board.

experience_source.quote: Have graduated with a graduate degree earned in an accredited advanced practice registered nurse education program

interval_years.quote: All license renewals shall be issued every 2 years in accordance with RSA 310:8.

required.quote: Applicants for license renewal and license reinstatement shall complete continuing education as follows

hours_per_period.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years.

period_years.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years.

value: APRN: 20 hours specific to specialty per 2 years
APRN: 5 hours pharmacology appropriate to specialty per 2 years
LNA: 12 hours per year (4 hours medication administration for those with medication administration certificate)
CALMA: 8 hours medication administration per 2 years
topical_requirements.quote: An APRN, in addition to the continuing education requirements to renew or reinstate a license as an RN, shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years, 20 hours of which shall be specific to the specialty for which renewal or reinstatement is sought, and 5 hours of which shall be training in pharmacology appropriate to the specialty

available.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.

requirements.value: Reciprocity/endorsement available if requirements of other state are substantially equivalent to NH requirements. NH is also a Nurse Licensure Compact member, allowing multistate licensure privileges.
requirements.quote: The nurse licensure compact is adopted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who shall practice or attempt to practice as a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or licensed nursing assistant in this state without a license shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor

title_protection.quote: Use, in connection with the individual's name, any designation tending to imply licensure as an RN, an LPN, or an LNA unless so licensed.

scope_protection.quote: Practice as a licensee without a license or when the license to do so has been revoked or suspended or when the license to do so has lapsed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that violates the security of the examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct that violates the security of the examination, including, but not limited to: Copying, disseminating, or receiving any portion of an examination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convictions by a court or any plea to a crime that relates adversely to the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Convictions by a court or any plea to a crime in any jurisdiction that relates adversely to the practice of nursing or to the ability to practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring a license or in representation to the board or public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing, in filing any reports or completing client records, in representation of oneself to the board or public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unethical conduct including conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unethical conduct including but not limited to conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or demonstrating a willful or careless disregard for the health or safety of a client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Nurse's license has been denied, revoked, suspended, or restricted in this or any other state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a nurse's license to practice nursing or a multi-state privilege or another health care related license or other credential has been denied, revoked, suspended, or restricted, or the licensee has been otherwise disciplined in this or any other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or inability to perform nursing practice with reasonable skill and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct including but not limited to failure or inability to perform nursing or nursing assistant practice as defined in this chapter, with reasonable skill and safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including departure from nursing standards, improper delegation, failure to supervise.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct including but not limited to: A departure from or failure to conform to nursing standards, including improper management of client records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any nursing practice that may create unnecessary danger to a client's life, health, or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any nursing practice that may create unnecessary danger to a client's life, health, or safety. Actual injury to a client need not be established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to illness or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice safely, including demonstration of actual or potential inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to clients by reason of illness or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying records, failure to cooperate with board investigation, boundary violations, abuse, sexual conduct with clients, workplace violence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Actions or conduct that include, but are not limited to, falsifying reports, client documentation, agency records, or other essential health documents, failure to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the board, failure to maintain professional boundaries with clients or family members, use of excessive force upon or mistreatment or abuse of any client, engaging in sexual conduct with a client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion or attempts to divert drugs or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion or attempts to divert drugs or controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to comply with terms of any alternative program agreement made with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to comply with terms of any alternative program agreement made with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances, drugs, or alcohol to an extent dangerous or injurious to self, others, or the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance or any drug or device or alcoholic beverages to an extent or in a manner dangerous or injurious to himself or herself, any other person, or the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, advising, or allowing an unlicensed person to engage in the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, advising, or allowing an unlicensed person to engage in the practice of nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a rule adopted by the board, an order of the board, or state/federal law relating to nursing or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a rule adopted by the board under RSA 541-A, an order of the board, a state or federal law relating to the practice of nursing, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing beyond the scope of practice as stated in this chapter, and failing to report violations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing beyond the scope of practice as stated in this chapter, and failing to report violations of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Upon notification by the licensing authority of another jurisdiction that a licensee has been disciplined.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon notification by the licensing authority of another jurisdiction that a licensee has been disciplined.

definition_quote.value: Nursing means assisting clients or groups of clients to attain or maintain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and by evaluating responses to nursing care and medical treatment.
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing" means assisting clients or groups of clients to attain or maintain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and by evaluating responses to nursing care and medical treatment.

value: prescribing and dispensing controlled and non-controlled drugs (APRN)
methods_authorized.quote: Performing acts of advanced assessment, diagnosing, prescribing, selecting, administering, and providing therapeutic measures and treatment regimes

drug_authority.value: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice. APRN may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine.
drug_authority.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice as defined by this chapter.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: Works under the direction of a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, dentist, or physician.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice as defined by this chapter.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRN may prescribe opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine after establishing an APRN-patient relationship; a subsequent in-person exam shall be conducted at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine after establishing an advanced practice registered nurse-patient relationship with the patient. When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine a subsequent in-person exam shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The office shall maintain a registry of nursing assistants who qualify pursuant to 42 C.F.R. section 483.156.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication nursing assistant" means a licensed nursing assistant holding a currently valid certificate authorizing the delegation to the nursing assistant of tasks of medication administration.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A nurse holding a currently valid license as an RN or an LPN may delegate specific nursing activities and tasks under the circumstances, and in accordance with the constraints, set forth in rules of the board adopted under RSA 541-A.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Every individual, agency, facility, institution, or organization that employs licensed nursing personnel within the state shall report to the board within 30 days any action by a licensee that willfully violates any provision of paragraph II.

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: No person may coerce an RN or an LPN into compromising client safety by requiring the nurse to delegate a nursing activity or task when the nurse determines that it is inappropriate to do so. A licensee shall not be subject to disciplinary action for refusing to delegate or refusing to provide training related to such delegation when the licensee has determined that such delegation may compromise client safety

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The nurse licensure compact is adopted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification shall contract with other organizations to operate the alternative recovery monitoring program for licensees who are impaired by substance use disorder or mental or physical illness.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An APRN may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine after establishing an APRN-patient relationship. A subsequent in-person exam must be conducted at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually. An out-of-state APRN providing services by means of telemedicine shall be deemed to be in the practice of medicine and shall be required to be licensed under this chapter.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine after establishing an advanced practice registered nurse-patient relationship with the patient. When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine a subsequent in-person exam shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.

military_education_credit_required.quote: The implementation of strategies and criteria necessary to increase the acceptance of military training and experience towards licensure for military veterans seeking to be licensed as a nurse.

scope__license_tiers.quote: "Registered nurse" or "RN" means an individual who holds a current license to practice registered nursing
"Licensed practical nurse" or "LPN" means an individual who holds a current license to practice practical nursing
"Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN" means a registered nurse currently licensed by the board under RSA 326-B:18.
"Licensed nursing assistant" or "LNA" means an individual who holds a current license to provide client care under the direction of a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse.
"Medication nursing assistant" means a licensed nursing assistant holding a currently valid certificate authorizing the delegation to the nursing assistant of tasks of medication administration.

No nursing home in the state may operate unless it is under the supervision of an administrator who holds a currently valid nursing home administrator's license and registration issued pursuant to this chapter.

"Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.
The board shall issue temporary licenses pursuant to this section to applicants who meet entry level licensing requirements in the license category.
